title: Canonical open cochain tensor adjunct and localization comparison maps
statement: For schemes $U,P$ and a morphism $j:U\to P$, use ordinary small etale module cochain and derived categories and localization $\ell$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. For a commutative ring $A$, let $F=j^*$, $G=j_*$ and let $F_c\dashv G_c$ be their induced adjunction on integer cochains. The tensor is the signed direct-sum total tensor [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves], with the canonical strong monoidal comparison $c$ [lem-pur-cochain-pullback-tensor-coherence]. For $A$-linear cochains $Q,I,J$ and a map $a:Q\otimes I\to J$, define $C_j(I)=G_cF_cI$ and define $v_j(Q,I,J,a):Q\otimes C_j(I)\to C_j(J)$ as the adjunct of $c_{Q,C_j(I)}$ followed by $1\otimes\varepsilon^0_{F_cI}$, then $c_{Q,I}^{-1}$ and $F_ca$. Use the published tensor-adjunct formula [def-pur-etale-kflat-support-data], specialized to the cochain adjunction. Define the exact-pullback representative isomorphism $p_{j,I}:Lj^*(\ell I)\simeq\ell(F_cI)$ as the published exact-pullback identification followed by the localization-factor isomorphism. Given $L\in D(P_{\mathrm{et}},A)$, $e_I:\ell I\simeq L$, and invertibility of the canonical right-derived comparison $\alpha_I:\ell C_j(I)\to Rj_*\ell(F_cI)$ [lem-sp-etale-derived-chain-transpose], define $d_{j,I,e_I}=Rj_*(Lj^*e_I\circ p_{j,I}^{-1})\circ\alpha_I:\ell C_j(I)\simeq Rj_*Lj^*L$. All maps are these composites; no injectivity assumption or arbitrary comparison is supplied.
